title: open-termbank: A Multi-domain English-Chinese Termbase
description: 多学科领域中英术语对照数据库（按域取用 / CSV+TBX / CC BY 4.0）。20 个学科领域，每条含英文术语、规范中文译名、领域标签、简明中文定义与英文同义词。A multi-domain English-Chinese terminology database with per-domain CSV files, TBX-Min export, brief Chinese definitions and English synonyms, synchronizable via index.json (per-domain sha256).
notes: Data: CC BY 4.0; code: Apache-2.0. Attribution: open-termbank contributors, CC BY 4.0. IATE-derived entries additionally carry: Download IATE, European Union, 2026.
